findings.rationale: Adopted: closed reader-allowlist guard added to check-canonical-invariants.sh — files may reference unratified only if they are producers, schemas, display-only projections (dispatch-status), the pass-through validator, tests, or docs; guard proven mutable-to-red by a synthetic authority-reader fixture.

Adopted for the envelope rail: salvage precondition = private_raw_reference present AND digest equals captured bytes, on every admitted failure classification; timeout-with-digest-mismatch fixture pins unratified:null with timeout classification preserved. Shell rail documented as digest-free by construction (dispatcher writes its own capture; no claim/verify split exists to contradict).

Adopted with modification: every valid salvage observation is retained per-attempt with CONTROLLER-side binding (attempt, target_id, family, request digest, raw digest — recorded by the code that parsed those exact bytes); seat-level summary emitted only when exactly one distinct payload exists, else an explicit unratified_conflict marker. In-band payload-contract attempt binding is NOT adopted: it adds a model-compliance failure mode while controller-side binding is mechanical and sufficient because each attempt's bytes are parsed in isolation. Earlier-valid/later-invalid and STOP-vs-READY conflict cases get fixtures.

Adopted: Fixture C was a phantom shape — the recorded 2026-08-20 in-tree incident is 0-byte stdout with NO raw reference (plan-review-transport-fixes.test.sh comment is the frozen source). Split into C-incident (0-byte, no reference → unratified null, negative control) and C-complete-timeout (explicitly labeled CONSTRUCTED, digest-bound raw with exact STOP payload → unratified present). Fixture bytes frozen with provenance + SHA-256; the aggregation destruction point is handled under the durable-storage finding. One recorded dead-gate mutation per rail with evidence paths.

Adopted (matches the depth-0 self-finding logged before G1 returned): field presence/nullability defined per status; shell emitters + validateReviewResult + schemas/review-result.schema.json + codex mirror + tests updated atomically in one commit; round-trip assertion proves a no_verdict artifact retains unratified_verdict while status/verdict stay fail-closed.

Adopted: all no_verdict paths route through one funnel receiving the human raw_log AND the runner-specific salvage capture path explicitly (capture topology differs per runner: PARSE_INPUT vs RAW_LOG vs KIMI_CLEAN vs AGY_PARSED); each branch keeps its exact error text, usage, passive-capture, status, exit code. Per-topology tests: one nonzero-with-complete-block and one truncated-block.

Adopted — claim verified true at dispatch-plan-review.js:1584-1591: the required_seat_transport_exhausted artifact omits reviewer_verdicts AND findings, destroying completed seats. Repair: exhaustion artifacts retain completed-seat observations (seat, target, attempt, transport provenance, parser status, verdict, findings) in an explicitly non-semantic field; semantic_verdict stays null, exit stays 4; panel manifest gains a boolean observation marker; dispatch-status renders it; artifact round-trip test.

Adopted with modification: plan gains a frozen rail inventory naming each verdict producer and its destruction boundary — engine implement-review transitively in scope via the shared result contract; qc-panel (own verdict.txt contract), qualification-review-provider (own purpose-bound JSON), adjudicate-findings (post-verdict intake, non-transport) out of scope with those reasons. The standing acceptance-search binding is NOT adopted this slice — the closed reader-allowlist guard already fails a new consumer of unratified fields, and a new verdict TRANSPORT is an engine-onboarding event; recorded as a BACKLOG trigger instead.

Adopted: salvage is the EXTRACTED authoritative battery itself (shared function over BLOCK_FILE: leak scan, 16 KB cap, single anchored VERDICT, FINDINGS, fence-aware NO-FINDING-PROOF count, field-structure regex, tautology blacklist) — never a re-listed subset; only the start-anchor is replaced by BEGIN/END uniqueness and the exit-code requirement dropped. Fixture: tautological SHIP proof interior → unratified null.

Adopted, merged with the check-canonical-invariants guard finding: closed reader allowlist (emit sites, dispatch-status display, tests, schema, pass-through validator); src/runners/review.js pinned to accept the key without copying into verdict/status (assertion); synthetic consumer that reads unratified_verdict as verdict turns the gate red (recorded mutation); separate from the salvage-presence dead-gate.

Adopted admission matrix verbatim: interrupted/unavailable salvage only when parser_status is strict AND private_raw_reference present; timeout/exit_failure/quota admit extracted only when objectCandidates finds exactly one complete object in that attempt's bytes; carry latest attempt whose salvage is strict, else null; empty/unreadable capture null; raw_binding_mismatch and identity_mismatch stay null; 0-byte 8/20 shape fixed as negative control.

Adopted: fixture bytes frozen from producer artifacts BEFORE coding where recoverable — the cc-shim notice text recovered from the v2.34.7 suppression code/tests in-tree, the 8/18-style raw-log chrome cited by path if a stored log exists; any shape not recoverable from a stored artifact is explicitly labeled CONSTRUCTED, never presented as incident bytes. C split per the sibling finding. Dead-gate mutations named per call site with evidence paths under docs/plans/evidence/2026-08-21-verdict-bytes-preservation/.

Adopted: unratified_verdict enters the schema as an OPTIONAL nullable enum admitted non-null on no_verdict only; REVIEW_RESULT_FIELDS extended with a never-copied-into-verdict/status pin; review-runner tests keep unknown-keys-fail while admitting this key; mirrors via sync-all; check-contract-schema.js explicitly out of scope (it reconciles the review-loop contract, not review-result — verified by reading its header).

Adopted (same repair as the funnel finding, both seats converged): the six inline printf no_verdict sites (codex :662, grok :702, qoder :749, cc-shim :880, claude-native :908, anthropic-compatible :932) route through the salvage-capable funnel; fixture with intact nonce block + non-zero rc on at least one currently-inline runner asserts unratified_verdict present, status no_verdict, exit 1.

Adopted as the plan's out-of-scope inventory bullet with the seat's own reasons: qc-panel judges (different verdict.txt contract), qualification-review-provider (own purpose-bound JSON), adjudicate-findings (post-verdict intake), engine implement-review (KR1 consumer under schema pinning, not a producer). No producer change for those rails this slice.
